title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-06-06

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a stellar acoustic fragment featuring Bob Weir's standout vocals on The Frozen Logger and Friend Of The Devil.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers crystal‑clear acoustic sound that reviewers describe as "fantastic" and "perfect," preserving an especially strong vocal performance from Bob Weir. Although only a fragment of the full set, the excerpt includes memorable renditions of The Frozen Logger and an acoustic Friend Of The Devil, making it a valuable snapshot of the 1970 acoustic shows.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently positive comments on both performance and sound quality across four reviews; excellent soundboard source and strong vocal highlight justify a high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, crisp acoustic mix with no reported flaws; reviewers repeatedly note the sound as fantastic or perfect.

show_quality.setlist_flow: An incomplete but high‑quality acoustic fragment that showcases strong vocal work and tight playing, offering a satisfying glimpse of the 1970 acoustic set.

band_member_comments.Bob: Weir's vocals are praised as among his strongest in this excerpt.
